annotations.text: Shown once, on first launch: confirm the default xylophone or go straight into color matching. The answer is saved on the device; changeable any time from the sliders button on the library screen.
Entry after first launch: a persistent icon button pinned to the header — always visible no matter how many songs (the earlier footer link scrolled out of view with a full song list).

Flip, presets and manual on one screen (flip row = whole-row tap target). Manual is not a separate mode: it always starts from the active palette (chosen preset or default) and edits one bar at a time. Metal + pastel preset palettes are placeholders — verify against best-selling toys before build.
Manual bars are ~36px wide on a 390 frame — same as the app's shipped reference strip; their 54–82px height keeps the tap area comfortable.
Happy path = tap a preset, tap save: 2 taps.

Swatch picker as a bottom sheet — bigger targets for one-handed use than a popover. 12 fixed swatches, each with a pre-measured label color; no free color wheel. Colors of the active preset always appear as swatches too.
Duplicate colors: non-blocking warning (existing amber chip tokens), save stays enabled — some real toys do repeat colors. The two matching bars get an amber ring.
